d: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her.  As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.
Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll.  Shelley Winters co-stars.

When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.
Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her.  As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead.  The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

En bergsby hemsöks av en vålnad i form av en liten mordisk flicka, vilket får en rättsläkare och en medicinstuderande att försöka avslöja hennes hemligheter medan en häxa använder sina konster för att skydda byborna.

En voodoo-förbannelse överför den döende seriemördaren Charles Lee Rays själ till Chucky, en Good Guys-docka. Den unge Andy får dockan i födelsedagspresent, och Chucky återupptar snart sin mordvåg. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

The eternally cool William Marshall puts a fresh spin on the age-old legend of the vampire, condemned to wander the Earth with an insatiable lust for blood in "Blacula," often credited as the first African-American horror film.

Charles Kessler, a high-profile town citizen, begins to act strangely after his wife leaves him and is brain damaged after a car accident.  Murders begin to occur and a man is falsely accused, and Kessler's daughter must find the killer.

A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him.  Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.
